statement: ∀ N : ℕ, let x := (N:ℝ); let lo := -(3*x+3)*Real.log 337; let hi := (-4*(3*x+15/7)+3*(6/7)+1)*Real.log 337; lo-hi=(9*x+2)*Real.log 337 ∧ hi<lo

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 迹、不同理想与 Fourier 缺额 · JA-0032 · 在固定 337 处算出逐元组上界和整格的缺额
plain_statement.en: New route · Trace, different and Fourier deficit · JA-0032 · Compute the growing mismatch of the tuple bound and lattice at 337

brief.zh: 用 q=337^(42N+30)、e=7、不同指数 6。在三槽 j=2 模型内展开全部常数。
brief.en: Use q=337^(42N+30), e=7 and different exponent 6. Expand the constants for j=2 in the three-slot model.
